newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Toshiba unit starts Philippine operation.
newsitem.headline: Toshiba unit starts Philippine operation.

text.p: Japan's Toshiba Corp said on Monday its subsidiary in the Philippines will start production on October 1.
The 1.4 billion peso information equipment plant is going to manufacture hard disk drives, optical drives, motherboards, and printed circuit boards for personal computers.

"Toshiba Information Equipment (Philippines) Inc is expected to play an important role in reinforcing Toshiba's price competitiveness in hard disk drives and optical disc drives," the company said in a statement.
The plant will undertake localised design and production and reduce costs by using components sourced from elsewhere in Asia, it added.
